nodes.title: A product identity for generalized Cohn matrices

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and $m \ge 2$, and suppose that some $k$-generalized Markov number $b$ equals $p^m$ or $2p^m$. Suppose moreover that either $k \ge 4$ is even and $p^2$ divides neither $k/2 + 1$ nor $k/2 - 1$, or $k$ is odd and $p^2$ divides neither $k + 2$ nor $k - 2$. Then $p$ does not divide $k^2 - 4$.
nodes.title: Discriminant condition for prime-power generalized Markov numbers

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime and $k$ a natural number. If either $k \ge 4$ is even and $p > k/2 + 1$, or $k$ is odd and $p > k + 2$, then $p$ does not divide $k^2 - 4$.
nodes.title: Large odd primes do not divide $k^2 - 4$

nodes.summary: If $(a, b, c)$ is a $k$-generalized Markov triple, then $\gcd(a, b) = \gcd(b, c) = \gcd(a, c) = 1$.
nodes.title: Generalized Markov triples are pairwise coprime

nodes.summary: Let $k$ be a natural number and let $S$ be the integer matrix with rows $(k, 0)$ and $(3k^2 + 3k, k)$. Let $(P, Q, R)$ be a $k$-generalized Cohn triple associated with $(a, b, c)$, and let $b' = \lfloor (a^2 + kac + c^2)/b \rfloor$. Then $(P, R, P^{-1}(R + S))$ is a $k$-generalized Cohn triple associated with $(a, c, b')$, and $((P + S)R^{-1}, P, R)$ is a $k$-generalized Cohn triple associated with $(b', a, c)$.
nodes.title: Parent triples of a generalized Cohn triple

nodes.summary: For all $A, B \in \mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$ we have $\operatorname{tr} A = \operatorname{tr} A^{-1}$, $\operatorname{tr}(AB) = \operatorname{tr} A \cdot \operatorname{tr} B - \operatorname{tr}(AB^{-1})$, and $A^2 = (\operatorname{tr} A) A - I$, where $I$ is the identity matrix.
nodes.title: Trace identities in $\mathrm{SL}(2, \mathbb{Z})$

nodes.summary: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $S$ be the integer matrix with rows $(k, 0)$ and $(3k^2 + 3k, k)$, and let $(P, Q, R)$ be a $k$-generalized Cohn triple associated with $(a, b, c)$. Then $(P, PQ - S, Q)$ is a $k$-generalized Cohn triple associated with $(a, \lfloor (a^2 + kab + b^2)/c \rfloor, b)$, and $(Q, QR - S, R)$ is a $k$-generalized Cohn triple associated with $(b, \lfloor (b^2 + kbc + c^2)/a \rfloor, c)$.
nodes.title: Children of a generalized Cohn triple

nodes.summary: If $(a, b, c)$ is a $k$-generalized Markov triple, then, as integers, $a^2 + kab + b^2 = c\,((3 + 3k)ab - c - k(a + b))$ and $b^2 + kbc + c^2 = a\,((3 + 3k)bc - a - k(b + c))$.
nodes.title: Vieta jumping identities for generalized Markov triples

nodes.summary: If $(a, b, c)$ is an induced solution of the $k$-generalized second Markov equation $\mathrm{GSME}(k)$, then so are $(a, ab - c - k^2 - 2k, b)$ and $(b, bc - a - k^2 - 2k, c)$.
nodes.title: Vieta jumping preserves induced solutions of the generalized second Markov equation

nodes.summary: Let $k$ be a natural number, $\ell$ an integer, and $S$ the integer matrix with rows $(k, 0)$ and $(3k^2 + 3k, k)$. For every path $w$ in the wide $k$-generalized Cohn tree $\mathrm{WGCT}(k, \ell)$, if $(P, Q, R)$ is the vertex at $w$, then the vertex at $w$ followed by a left step is $(P, PQ - S, Q)$ and the vertex at $w$ followed by a right step is $(Q, QR - S, R)$; that is, each child is obtained from its parent…
nodes.title: Children in the wide generalized Cohn tree

nodes.summary: Let $k$ be a natural number. For every integer $\ell$ and every path $w$, the vertex of the wide $k$-generalized Cohn tree $\mathrm{WGCT}(k, \ell)$ at $w$ is a $k$-generalized Cohn triple associated with the vertex of the wide $k$-generalized Markov tree $\mathrm{WMT}(k)$ at $w$. Moreover, every $k$-generalized Markov triple $(a, b, c)$ with $a \le b$ and $c \le b$ has an associated $k$-generalized Cohn triple.
nodes.title: Vertices of the wide generalized Cohn tree are generalized Cohn triples

nodes.summary: For every natural number $k$ and every integer $\ell$, if the vertices $(P, Q, R)$ and $(P', Q', R')$ of the wide $k$-generalized Cohn tree $\mathrm{WGCT}(k, \ell)$ at paths $w$ and $w'$ (finite sequences of left and right steps) satisfy $Q = Q'$, then $w = w'$.
nodes.title: Distinct paths give distinct middle matrices in the wide generalized Cohn tree

nodes.summary: Fix a natural number $k$ and an integer $\ell$, and let $S = \begin{pmatrix} k & 0 \\ 3k^2 + 3k & k \end{pmatrix}$. nodes.summary: For every natural number $k$, every path $w$ and every direction $d$ (left or right), the vertex of the wide $k$-generalized Markov tree $\mathrm{WMT}(k)$ at the path $w$ followed by one step in direction $d$ is the image of the vertex at $w$ under the Vieta jumping in direction $d$.
nodes.title: Children in the wide generalized Markov tree are Vieta jumpings

nodes.summary: Let $k$ be a natural number. Every vertex of the wide $k$-generalized Markov tree $\mathrm{WMT}(k)$ is a $k$-generalized Markov triple. Moreover, every $k$-generalized Markov triple $(a, b, c)$ with $a < b$ and $c < b$ is the vertex of $\mathrm{WMT}(k)$ at exactly one path that starts with a left step, and at exactly one path that starts with a right step.
nodes.title: Generalized Markov triples in the wide Markov tree

nodes.summary: Fix a natural number $k$. The wide $k$-generalized Markov tree $\mathrm{WMT}(k)$ is the binary tree of triples of natural numbers with root $(1, 1, 1)$ in which a vertex $(a, b, c)$ has left child $(a, \lfloor (a^2 + kab + b^2)/c \rfloor, b)$ and right child $(b, \lfloor (b^2 + kbc + c^2)/a \rfloor, c)$, the left and right Vieta jumpings. can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
